newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair to meet Irish premier ahead of parade.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair to meet Irish premier ahead of parade.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair will have a first meeting with new Irish premier Bertie Ahern on Thursday to discuss Northern Ireland, British officials said on Monday.
The meeting in London follows the announcement last week of new proposals by Blair to kick-start the peace process in the British-ruled province.

It also comes three days before a controversial Protestant parade through a Catholic enclave in the town of Drumcree near Portadown on July 6, which all political sides fear could pitch Northern Ireland into a new cycle of sectarian violence.
Attempts to seek a compromise over the parade between Protestants loyal to British rule and Republicans who seek unity with Ireland have so far failed.
Tension has been high in Northern Ireland for weeks since the IRA shot dead two policemen in the town of Lurgan after a wave of small-scale attacks by Protestant gunmen.
